quests.instruction: Why do foods like milk and yogurt belong in the fridge?
quests.correctAnswer: Cold slows down the germs that spoil food 🧊
options: Cold kills every germ in the food ❄️
Cold slows down the germs that spoil food 🧊
Cold makes milk and yogurt taste sweeter 🍬
quests.hint: Ask yourself what happens to food that sits somewhere warm.
quests.explanation: Germs grow fastest in warm places. The cold of a fridge slows them down, so food stays fresh longer.
quests.funFact: Most germs grow quickly between about five and sixty degrees Celsius, so foods are kept colder or hotter than that.

quests.instruction: What food should go straight into the fridge when you get home from the shop?
quests.correctAnswer: Raw chicken 🍗
options: Raw chicken 🍗
Dry pasta 🍝
Canned beans 🥫
quests.hint: It is fresh and can spoil quickly.
quests.explanation: Raw chicken spoils quickly if it is left warm. Canned beans and dry pasta keep well on a shelf.
quests.funFact: Cans and dry foods can wait on a shelf, but raw meat should be chilled as soon as possible.

quests.instruction: About how cold should the inside of a fridge be?
quests.correctAnswer: About 4°C (40°F) 🧊
options: About 30°C (86°F) ☀️
About 20°C (68°F) 🌡️
About 4°C (40°F) 🧊
quests.hint: It should feel like a very cold winter day.
quests.explanation: A fridge at about 4°C (40°F) is cold enough to slow the growth of germs. Room temperature and a hot day are far too warm.
quests.funFact: A fridge thermometer helps make sure the temperature stays cold enough.

quests.instruction: Which sign shows that bread has gone bad?
quests.correctAnswer: Fuzzy green or white spots 🍞
options: Fuzzy green or white spots 🍞
A golden brown crust on top 🍞
A soft, springy middle inside 🍞
quests.hint: Look at the surface of the slice.
quests.explanation: Fuzzy spots are mold, so the bread should be thrown away.
quests.funFact: Mold can send tiny roots deep into soft foods, so cutting off the spots is not enough.

quests.instruction: A carton of milk smells sour and has lumps in it. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Do not drink it, and tell a grown-up 🚫
options: Stir in sugar to hide the taste 🍬
Drink it quickly before it gets worse 🥛
Do not drink it, and tell a grown-up 🚫
quests.hint: Your nose is giving you a warning.
quests.explanation: Sour smell and lumps mean the milk has spoiled. It is not safe to drink.
quests.funFact: Milk turns sour when germs change its natural sugar into acid.

quests.instruction: Which two senses can warn you that food has gone bad before you taste it?
quests.correctAnswer: Sight and smell 👃
options: Taste and hearing 👅
Sight and smell 👃
Hearing and balance 👂
quests.hint: Check with your eyes and nose first.
quests.explanation: Looking and sniffing can show mold, strange colors and sour smells. Tasting spoiled food can make you sick.
quests.funFact: Slimy surfaces, strange colors and sour smells are common signs that food has spoiled.

quests.instruction: A package says 'use by' with a date. What does that date tell you?
quests.correctAnswer: The last day it should be eaten 📅
options: The day it was grown on a farm 🌱
The day it was bought at the shop 🛒
The last day it should be eaten 📅
quests.hint: Think about a deadline.
quests.explanation: A use-by date is the last day the food should be eaten. After that day it may not be safe.
quests.funFact: Foods that spoil quickly, like fresh meat and milk, usually have use-by dates.

quests.instruction: What does 'best before' on a food label mainly tell you?
quests.correctAnswer: When the food tastes its best 🏅
options: When the food tastes its best 🏅
How much the food weighs in total ⚖️
When the food was first cooked 🍳
quests.hint: It is about quality, not danger.
quests.explanation: 'Best before' is about quality. After that date the food may be less tasty, though it is not always unsafe.
quests.funFact: Dry foods like pasta and cereal often carry best-before dates.

quests.instruction: In a shop, two cartons of milk have different dates. Which is likely to stay fresh longer?
quests.correctAnswer: The carton with the later date 📅
options: The carton with the earlier date 📅
The carton with the later date 📅
They will last exactly as long 📅
quests.hint: Look closely at the numbers.
quests.explanation: A later date means more days before the milk spoils. Shoppers often check dates before choosing.
quests.funFact: Shops put older stock at the front so that it is sold first.

quests.instruction: After dinner there is leftover soup. What should happen to it?
quests.correctAnswer: Cover it and put it in the fridge soon 🧊
options: Cover it and put it in the fridge soon 🧊
Leave it on the stove overnight 🍲
Leave it on the table until breakfast 🌙
quests.hint: Germs grow quickly in warm food.
quests.explanation: Leftovers should be covered and chilled soon after a meal. Soup left out overnight can spoil.
quests.funFact: A big pot of soup cools faster when it is split into smaller containers.

quests.instruction: How should leftovers be reheated?
quests.correctAnswer: Until steaming hot all the way through ♨️
options: Just until they feel warm to the touch 🌡️
Until steaming hot all the way through ♨️
Until the top of the food looks dry 🍂
quests.hint: The heat has to reach the middle.
quests.explanation: Leftovers should be hot all the way through, which helps kill germs that grew while the food was stored.
quests.funFact: Stirring leftovers while they heat helps the warmth spread evenly.

quests.instruction: Why can frozen food be kept much longer than fresh food?
quests.correctAnswer: Freezing stops germs from growing 🧊
options: Freezing makes the food much heavier ⚖️
Freezing makes the food taste sweeter 🍬
Freezing stops germs from growing 🧊
quests.hint: Ask yourself what germs need to grow.
quests.explanation: Germs cannot grow when food is frozen, so frozen food keeps for months.
quests.funFact: Freezing does not kill all germs, so frozen food still needs to be cooked properly.

quests.instruction: A can of beans is badly dented and bulging at the top. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Do not use it, and tell a grown-up 🚫
options: Open it and eat the beans cold anyway 🥫
Do not use it, and tell a grown-up 🚫
Shake it hard to flatten the top 🔄
quests.hint: The can is giving a warning sign.
quests.explanation: A bulging can can mean germs are making gas inside. It should not be opened or eaten.
quests.funFact: Bulging cans can mean germs have been growing inside, so they are thrown away.

quests.instruction: What is the best way to store dry rice or pasta?
quests.correctAnswer: In a sealed box in a cool, dry place 🫙
options: Uncovered on a warm, sunny windowsill ☀️
Soaking in a big bowl of water 💧
In a sealed box in a cool, dry place 🫙
quests.hint: Consider keeping out damp and insects.
quests.explanation: A sealed container in a cool, dry place keeps moisture and insects away.
quests.funFact: Lids keep out moisture and insects, the main enemies of stored grains.

quests.instruction: Which food can sit in a cupboard for a very long time without spoiling?
quests.correctAnswer: Honey 🍯
options: Honey 🍯
Cut melon 🍈
Cooked rice 🍚
quests.hint: Germs struggle to grow in it because it is so sugary.
quests.explanation: Honey is so sugary and so low in water that germs cannot grow in it easily. Cut melon and cooked rice spoil quickly.
quests.funFact: Honey is so sugary and so low in water that germs struggle to grow in it.

quests.instruction: At a picnic on a hot day, how can you keep cheese sandwiches safe to eat?
quests.correctAnswer: Keep them in a cooler with ice packs 🧊
options: Put them in a bag on a warm car seat 🚗
Leave them on a blanket in the sun ☀️
Keep them in a cooler with ice packs 🧊
quests.hint: Keep them cold.
quests.explanation: Ice packs keep food cold, and cold slows germs. Sun and a hot car would warm the food too much.
quests.funFact: A cooler works best when it is full and kept closed.

quests.instruction: Cold foods that spoil easily should not sit out for more than about how long?
quests.correctAnswer: About two hours ⏱️
options: About a whole day ☀️
About two hours ⏱️
About a whole week 📅
quests.hint: It is much shorter than a day.
quests.explanation: Perishable foods should not sit out for more than about two hours. A day or a week is far too long.
quests.funFact: On a very hot day, food should not sit out for more than an hour.

quests.instruction: Where is the best place to put a cooler at a picnic?
quests.correctAnswer: In the shade 🌳
options: In the shade 🌳
Beside the campfire 🔥
In direct sunlight ☀️
quests.hint: Think about keeping the cold in.
quests.explanation: Shade keeps the cooler from heating up. Sunlight and fire would warm everything inside.
quests.funFact: A cooler holds the cold in, but sunshine heats it from the outside.

quests.instruction: Which of these should never go into a microwave oven?
quests.correctAnswer: A metal fork 🍴
options: A paper plate marked microwave-safe 🍽️
A metal fork 🍴
A microwave-safe bowl 🥣
quests.hint: It can make sparks.
quests.explanation: Metal can make sparks in a microwave, which is dangerous. Bowls and plates marked microwave-safe are made for it.
quests.funFact: Microwaves heat food by making the water inside it vibrate.

quests.instruction: You smell something burning in the kitchen. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a grown-up straight away 📢
options: Tell a grown-up straight away 📢
Hide the pan in a cupboard 🚪
Ignore it and keep playing 🎮
quests.hint: A grown-up needs to know quickly.
quests.explanation: Burning smells can be a warning of fire. Telling a grown-up right away keeps everyone safe.
quests.funFact: A smoke alarm gives an early warning, so grown-ups test it regularly.

quests.instruction: Which of these should never be left alone while someone is cooking?
quests.correctAnswer: A pot on a hot stove 🍳
options: A cold bowl of salad 🥗
A basket of fruit 🧺
A pot on a hot stove 🍳
quests.hint: Ask yourself what could get too hot.
quests.explanation: A pot on a hot stove can boil over or burn, so someone must stay nearby. Salad and fruit are not heated.
quests.funFact: Most kitchen fires start when cooking is left unattended.

quests.instruction: A basket of strawberries has one moldy berry. What is the best thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Throw it away and check the others 🍓
options: Throw it away and check the others 🍓
Scrape off the mold and eat the rest 🍓
Eat the moldy one quickly before it spoils 🍓
quests.hint: Mold can spread to berries that touch it.
quests.explanation: Moldy fruit should be thrown away, and the other berries should be checked for mold.
quests.funFact: Mold spreads quickly between berries that touch, so the whole container should be checked.

quests.instruction: Cooked chicken was left on the counter all night. What should happen to it?
quests.correctAnswer: Throw it away 🗑️
options: Reheat it and eat it ♨️
Eat it cold for breakfast 🍗
Throw it away 🗑️
quests.hint: Ask yourself how long it sat in the warmth.
quests.explanation: Cooked food left out for many hours can grow harmful germs, so it should be thrown away.
quests.funFact: Reheating cannot always make food safe once it has sat out for too long.

quests.instruction: You are not sure whether some leftovers are still safe. What is a good rule?
quests.correctAnswer: When in doubt, throw it out 🗑️
options: A tiny taste will tell you 👅
When in doubt, throw it out 🗑️
Add extra salt to be safe 🧂
quests.hint: It is better to be safe than sorry.
quests.explanation: If you are unsure, it is safest not to eat the food. Tasting or adding salt cannot make it safe.
quests.funFact: Tasting even a tiny bit of spoiled food can make you sick.

quests.instruction: Which tool checks that meat is cooked to a safe heat in the middle?
quests.correctAnswer: Food thermometer 🌡️
options: Kitchen timer ⏲️
Kitchen scale ⚖️
Food thermometer 🌡️
quests.hint: It tells you how hot something is.
quests.explanation: A food thermometer measures the temperature inside the meat. A scale weighs food and a timer counts minutes.
quests.funFact: Cooks put the thermometer into the thickest part, away from the bone.

quests.instruction: What is the safest way to thaw frozen chicken?
quests.correctAnswer: In the fridge 🧊
options: In a warm car 🚗
In the fridge 🧊
On the counter all day 🌞
quests.hint: Keep it cold while it thaws.
quests.explanation: Thawing in the fridge keeps the chicken cold while it softens, so germs cannot grow quickly.
quests.funFact: Thawing in the fridge is slow, so cooks plan ahead the day before.

quests.instruction: You come home from the shop with bags of groceries. Which foods should you put away first?
quests.correctAnswer: Cold and frozen foods 🧊
options: Cold and frozen foods 🧊
Cookies and crackers 🍪
Cans and jars 🥫
quests.hint: Think about which foods could warm up.
quests.explanation: Cold and frozen foods can warm up and spoil, so they go in the fridge or freezer first.
quests.funFact: Shops often pack cold items together so that they stay cold on the way home.

quests.instruction: Which list contains only safe food habits?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash hands, chill leftovers, check dates 🧼
options: Skip washing, ignore dates, eat dropped food 🗑️
Wash hands, chill leftovers, check dates 🧼
Taste raw dough, leave soup out, share spoons 🥄
quests.hint: Look for the list where nothing spreads germs.
quests.explanation: Washing hands, chilling leftovers and checking dates all keep food safe. The other lists spread germs or ignore warnings.
quests.funFact: Food safety experts sum up the basics as clean, separate, cook and chill.

quests.instruction: A friend says a cheese sandwich that sat in a hot car all day is fine to eat. What would you say?
quests.correctAnswer: It was in the heat too long to be safe 🚗
options: It is fine as long as you eat it quickly 🏃
It is fine because the bread protects it 🍞
It was in the heat too long to be safe 🚗
quests.hint: Ask yourself how hot a car gets.
quests.explanation: Food that sits somewhere hot for hours can grow harmful germs, and eating it quickly does not help.
quests.funFact: Cars can get much hotter than the air outside, so food should never be left in them.

quests.instruction: Which list shows safe steps for leftovers, in the right order?
quests.correctAnswer: Cool, cover, chill, reheat until hot 🧊
options: Cool, cover, chill, reheat until hot 🧊
Chill, reheat until hot, cover, cool 🧊
Reheat until hot, cool, cover, chill 🧊
quests.hint: The food goes in the fridge before it is reheated later.
quests.explanation: Leftovers are cooled, covered and chilled soon after the meal, and reheated until hot before they are eaten.
quests.funFact: Leftovers are best eaten within about three to four days.
